notes.subject: ruakh
notes.rationale: רוח ke ruakh ka boona — moya, phefo le go hema ka lentšu le tee; ga go ngwalwe 'moya' fela.

notes.subject: mesong le lefsifsi
notes.rationale: עשה שחר עיפה: KJV 'morning darkness' kgathanong le 'o fetola mesong go ba lefsifsi' — go direga thwii goba go fetoga ga maemo.

notes.subject: se a se nagago
notes.rationale: מה שחו: 'nagana ya gagwe' (motho) kgathanong le 'se a se bolelago' (Elohim) — bothi bja moladi bo sa hlaka.

notes.subject: במתי
notes.rationale: diphahlo — במה e ka bolela gape aletare tša dithaba; moya wa direto o lahlegile.

notes.subject: a bolelelago motho se a se nagago
notes.rationale: Elohim o senola se hwetšago mothong a se bonyeletše — go senolwa ga se sieo.

translation: Gore bona, yo a bopago dithaba, gomme yo a bopago ⟨go⟩ ruakh, gomme a bolelelago motho se a se nagago, yo a dirago mesong le lefsifsi, gomme a sepelago godimo ga diphahlo tša lefase — Yahwe, Elohim wa Tsebaote, ke leina la gagwe.
